entries.text: Pamphlets at the exit only! Only one per person!
This is the end of you!
The iks have always been ours.
A prayer to the almighty one!
Healing is what I do best.
I'll take your place when you are gone.
Feel the power of the Mooh'Tah!
I AM MORGAROTH, LORD OF THE TRIANGLE... AND YOU ARE LOST!
MY SEED IS FEAR AND MY HARVEST ARE YOUR SOULS!
ZATHROTH! LOOK AT THE DESTRUCTION I AM CAUSING IN YOUR NAME!
THE TRIANGLE OF TERROR WILL RISE!
You will make a fine trophy.
Let me hear the music of battle.
Another one to bite the dust!
To be the one you'll have to beat the one!
Where did I put my ultimate health potion again?
I'll take your ears as a trophy!
Come on, you don't really need this. Just let me go.
Let us leave safely and maybe we'll give you a few coins.
That cowardish dwarven bank keeper ran when he saw the three of us.
You humans have enough to spare. We live in poverty.
You are starting to annoy me!
I will restore our family honor!
I love the smell of rotten flesh.
The earth will take you back.
I'm the hunter and you are my prey!
I kept my axe sharp, especially for you!
Time for a little torturing practice!
Take that creature off my back!! I can feel it!
You will regret interrupting my studies!
You will be the next infected one... CRAAAHHH!
Run as fast as you can.
Oh by the gods! What is this... aaaaaargh!
I'm Zulazza, and you won't forget me that fazzt.
Oh, HE will take revenge on zzizz azzault when you zztep in front of HIZZ fazze!
Fear the wrath of the wronged!
You will rise as my servant!
Close your eyes... I want to show you something.
Peak a boo, I killed you!
I've been in the shadow under your bed last night.
You never know what hides in the night.
I remember your face - and I know where you sleep.
Only the sweetest and cruelest dreams for you, my love.
We are the true sons of the desert!
I will leave your remains to the vultures!
We are swift as the wind of the desert!
I will leave your remains to the vultures!
We are the true sons of the desert!
We are swift as the wind of the desert!
I will leave your remains to the vultures!
We are the true sons of the desert!
We are swift as the wind of the desert!
Revenge is sweetest when served cold.
You will not tell anyone what you have seen!
Looking at a nymph can blind you. Be careful, mortal being!
Are you one of those evil nightmare creatures? Leave this realm alone!
Come here, sweetheart! I won't hurt you! *giggle*
Deixe-me dar uma olhada em voce!
FIRST I'LL OBLITERATE YOU THEN I BURN THIS PRISON DOWN!!
I'M TOO HOT FOR YOU TO HANDLE!
THE POWER OF HIS INTERNAL FIRE RENEWS OMRAFIR!
I WILL RULE WHEN THE NEW ORDER IS ESTABLISHED!
INFERNATIL! COME HERE AND FIGHT ME YOU COWARD!
Now chhhou shhhee me ... Now chhhou don't.
Chhhhou are marked ashhh my prey.
I'll kill you slow and painful.
PRAISED BE MY MASTERS, THE RUTHLESS SEVEN!
Be prepared for the day my masters will come for you!
I could be your evil twin!
I'll take your place when you are gone.
Hope you die and loooosh it!
Oh my, you forgot to put your pants on!
Dream a little dream with me!
Oh my, you forgot to put your pants on!
Dream a little dream with me!
Do you really want to hurt me?
You will not get my treasure.
Glamour, glitter, glistering things! Do you have any of those?
You might be a threat! I'm sorry but I can't allow you to linger here.
Let's try a step or two!
I CAN SENSE YOUR BODY ROTTING!
You are looking a bit feverish!
You will not live to tell anyone!
Look what has stepped into my trap!
This was the initial trick, but the second follows quick!
Look into my eyes! No, the other ones!
The mirrors can't contain the night!
There is nothing here for you and you will die alone.
You will obey and you will kneel and you will BOW TO US.
Now your life is come to the end, hahahaha!
Throw the soul on the altar!
There is only one true sun!
There can only be one world!
Magic is only good for girls!
Uh, I can't hear anymore. I am deaf!
They've ruined it! I can't cheat anymore!
They used you fools to escape and they left ME behind!!??
NOT EVEN AEONS OF IMPRISONMENT WILL STOP ME!
EVEN WITH ALL THAT TIME IN THE PRISON THAT WEAKENED ME, YOU ARE NO MATCH TO ME!
We will make you one of us!
YOU WILL REGRET THAT YOU ARE BORN!
Behold the all permeating powers I draw from this gate!!
I WILL RETURN!! My death will just be a door to await my homecoming, my physical hull will be... my... argh...
It's not a trick, it's Rahemos.
I will make you believe in magic.
The moon broke and I followed!
It burns! But it makes me stronger!
This is a nightmare and you won't wake up!
YOUR FUTILE ATTACKS ONLY FEED MY RAGE!
Let's see how good you are!
My little beetles, go forth, eat, feast!
Banks are meant to be robbed. It's my job!
That bank chick was trembling in fear. I love it!
You are too soft for a fight.
The Moon Goddess has forsaken us!
Death is too good for them.
I can kill a man in a thousand ways. And that`s only with a spoon!
You are no match for a master assassin!
I'll teach you the art of death!
Where... have you been all that time?
What...? How dare you? Give me that back!
I am the master of this ship!
THE DARK TIDE WILL SWALLOW YOU...
When I'm finished with you, you'll be a shadow of your former self.
Come forth from the shadows, my minions...
The shadows follow your every step...
I WILL FEAST ON YOUR SOUL!
FEEL THE TRUE MEANING OF VANQUISH!
HAHAHAHA DO YOU WANT TO AMUSE YOUR MASTER?
A battle makes the blood so hot and sweet.
I will make your death look like an accident!
You should not have interferred with my business!
Bribes are expensive, murder ist cheap!
I see some profit in your death!
ZHE TIME OF ZHE SNAKE HAZ COME!
I'll take your place when you are gone.
Life is such a fickle thing!
Nothing better than plundering and getting plastered!
When the dust settles there will only be one.
I will turn you into ashes.
No I don't work in the mines right now. That's my day off.
Please do not obstruct our work.
So much work in the Chocolate Mines!
YOU HAVE BAD BREATH, TAKE A MINT!!!
No mommy NO, Leave me alone!
The cat has grown some horns!
What was I doing here again?
Nightmarish monster! This dream is not meant for you!
You won't steal my robe! Back off!
You are not allowed to lay eyes on me in this shape!
Are you stalking me? You will bitterly regret this!
Mourn the dead, do not hunt them!
Terofar cast a greater death curse on you!
IT TOOK AN ARMY OF YOUR KIND TO DEFEAT THE WARDEN. NOW YOU ARE ALONE!
THE WARDS ARE FAILING! MY ESCAPE IS ONLY A MATTER OF TIME!!
FEELS GOOD TO BE BACK IN ACTION!
I will eat you in your sleep.
I am the darkness around you...
You will become a feast for my maggots!
Nobody will ever escape from this place, muwahaha!!!
I AM THE ESSENCE OF DEATH!
HUNGER ... SO ... GREAT! YOU ALL .. WILL .... DIE!!!
Feel the power of death unleashed!
I will rule again and my realm of death will span the world!
My lich-knights will conquer this world for me!
Leave as long as you can.
